goalbuddy_receipt_v1.rationale: Not ready for final audit. The full automated gate passes, but adversarial probes exposed two high-severity transaction-lifecycle failures: browser accept/revert never reaches the producer-visible server status, and a disconnect after receiving an SSE frame but before acknowledgement can permanently strand that transaction. Pending review can also be orphaned by switching files, and valid explicit replacement of a self-contained layer with internal resources is incorrectly rejected. The recorded browser oracle is credible but lacks a durable exported artifact or replayable harness. One coherent remediation Worker package can close these gaps without changing the approved architecture; T999 must remain queued until it passes.

evidence.finding: Independent npm run check passed typecheck, 10 test files, 111 tests, and production build. npm audit --audit-level=high reported 0 vulnerabilities. git diff --check passed. These gates are useful but do not exercise terminal review acknowledgements, the receive-before-ack reconnect window, pending file switches, or self-contained resource replacement.

Accept/revert is only local. src/client/main.ts:468-483 calls AgentSession.accept/revert and updates local review state, but AgentCanvasTransport exposes only the staging acknowledgement at src/client/agent/transport.ts:73-86. src/server/agent-transport.ts:194-210 accepts acknowledgements only while status is delivered and only understands rejected/staged/applied; it has no pending_review -> accepted/reverted transition. An independent real-HTTP probe staged terminal-audit, attempted an accepted acknowledgement, then queried producer status; staged, terminalAttempt, and producerStatus all remained pending_review. This violates structured acknowledgement and makes the agent unable to learn the human decision.

src/client/agent/transport.ts:58-60 advances Last-Event-ID before transaction acknowledgement succeeds. On disconnect, src/server/agent-transport.ts:159-170 resets delivered to queued, but reconnect replay at 152-157 sends only event.id > Last-Event-ID. An independent real-HTTP probe received event 1, disconnected before ack, reconnected with Last-Event-ID 1, and received only the connected comment while producer status remained queued. The unacknowledged transaction is therefore not replayed. Existing reconnect tests cover queued event 2 after Last-Event-ID 1, not this required receive-before-ack fault window.

The pending mutation freeze is incomplete. src/client/main.ts:602-619 permits file buttons while a proposal is pending and checks only dirty manual edits. openSvg at 626-675 replaces the canonical document and AgentSession.open clears pending state without a review decision or server acknowledgement. This can leave the producer status pending_review, stale review UI, and a proposal detached from its document. File switching is a document mutation and must be blocked or explicitly revert the pending transaction first.

src/client/agent/transaction.ts:135-148 treats every pre-transaction reference as a permanent obligation, even references wholly inside an explicitly replaced subtree. An independent probe replaced a self-contained logo group containing old-gradient plus its internal url(#old-gradient) with a self-contained group using new-gradient; evaluation incorrectly returned reference_damage for old-gradient. External references must remain protected, but references removed together with their explicitly replaced owner should not block a valid logo-designer replacement.

src/server/agent-transport.ts:129 counts all historical events against maxBacklog, while terminal events are never removed from #events. A long-lived local session eventually rejects every new submission even after earlier transactions finish. Remediation should retain bounded idempotency records while pruning terminal events from the active delivery backlog.

docs/oracle/T006-logo-designer.md records a real Chromium flow, exact hash, structural assertions, viewports, keyboard operation, and clean console, and T006 receipts a real adapter invocation. However no exported SVG bytes or replayable browser harness exists under docs/oracle, scripts, or tests; the sole durable artifact is the narrative receipt. The final clean-export claim should be backed by the actual saved/reopened SVG artifact and a deterministic structural/hash verifier rerun after remediation.

Strict version/field/operation parsing, 5 MiB and 100-operation bounds, malformed JSON rejection, exact operation references, detached rollback, stale revision, missing/ambiguous/locked targets, invalid reorder and paint, script/foreignObject/SMIL/event/style/external URL rejection, ID collision detection, and untouched unsupported-content preservation are covered in tests/agent-protocol.test.ts and tests/agent-transaction.test.ts and passed independently in the 111-test gate.

Real-HTTP tests prove ordered tx-1/tx-2 delivery, exact-byte duplicate idempotency, conflicting-payload 409, newest-editor ownership, delivery timeout, disconnected status, payload/backlog limits, and ordinary Last-Event-ID replay. The receive-before-ack reconnect case fails as described, and terminal accepted/reverted duplicate semantics are absent.

tests/agent-review.test.ts proves nested, direct-hidden, locked, and multi-selected impact labels; transaction tests reject locked ancestors/descendants and permit hidden targets. The review UI provides accessible locate labels, an aria-live summary, keyboard-operable preview/accept/revert controls, canvas/layer markers, and isolated preview serialization. T008 and T006 record real-browser responsive and keyboard checks with a clean console. These pass for the exercised states, subject to pending file-switch remediation.

tests/agent-history.test.ts proves failed/reverted proposals create no checkpoint, acceptance creates one checkpoint, undo/redo restore hierarchy/scope/multi-selection, and revision remains monotonic. Fidelity/workspace tests preserve width/height, IDs, transforms, resources, text, style-bearing untouched content, use/symbol, custom attributes, and unrelated metadata while removing reserved lineage metadata. The full gate passes; only the over-restrictive explicit replacement case remains.

Versioned commands without reload: pass for ordinary delivery. Accurate isolated review: pass for exercised impacts. Accept/revert: local UI pass, producer-visible lifecycle fail. Coherent undo/redo: pass. Stale/atomic/trust protections: pass. Disconnect/reconnect without loss or duplication: fail in receive-before-ack window. Logo-designer public adapter: pass for representative fixture, but valid internal-resource replacement is over-rejected. Save/reopen clean export: automated fidelity pass and narrative browser pass, but durable final artifact missing. Overall oracle: fail until remediation.

T005 remains status blocked even though T008 is done and explicitly completed its blocked real-browser verification. Board truth should preserve the original blocked receipt but record T005 as resolved_by T008 or otherwise remove it from unresolved required Worker work before T999.

parallel_safety.reason: The remediation crosses the shared protocol, server state machine, client SSE cursor, session pending state, main review/file lifecycle, transaction reference validation, and their integration tests. Parallel writers would overlap the same contracts and could mask ordering defects; use one Worker package.

blocked_tasks.reason: Final completion audit is blocked until terminal decision acknowledgement, lossless pre-ack reconnect, pending file lifecycle, internal-resource replacement, and durable oracle evidence are remediated and verified.

missing_evidence: Producer-visible accepted and reverted terminal statuses through the real authenticated API.
Lossless exactly-once recovery when SSE disconnects after frame receipt but before staging acknowledgement.
A verified pending-review file-switch policy that cannot orphan the transaction.
Successful explicit replacement of a self-contained layer whose old and new internal resource IDs differ, while external reference damage remains rejected.
Durable saved/reopened oracle SVG bytes plus a replayable structural/hash verification record.
Board resolution linking T005 completion to T008.
